items.name: fonts
items.title: Fonts
items.description: The @font-face block, subset by unicode-range. Not enough on its own: nothing is fetched from Google at runtime, so the four woff2 files have to be copied and served yourself.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: Two grounds, no accent hue, both themes first-class with a no-JS fallback. Every other item derives from these; nothing below this layer may contain a hex.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion — the spring
items.description: A critically-damped spring, parameterised the way Apple parameterises it: damping ratio and response in seconds. Re-targeting keeps position and velocity, so a reversal blends instead of hitting a wall.

items.name: headline
items.title: Headline
items.description: One sentence, two voices. The setup clause is muted at weight 500, the payoff is full strength at 800 — a typographic device, not decoration. Tracking is size-specific because one value is wrong somewhere.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Mono, uppercase, wide tracking. Mono is for what a machine would emit, so this and only this carries indices, keys and attributions.

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: Value, label, and a source line. The source is not optional decoration: it is what turns the number into evidence.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: Fluid vertical rhythm and a heading row whose rule expands to fill whatever the title leaves. Sits inside a .band, which tokens.css owns.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack & row
items.description: Two classes instead of a style attribute on every block that needs its children spaced. The sites this is built for ship style-src self with no unsafe-inline, so an inline style is not a shortcut — it is silently dropped.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Set --as-grid-min and the column count follows from the space available. There are no media queries in this file and there do not need to be.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Glass is reserved for things that float, and a card in a grid does not float. Works as a whole link, in which case the border goes full strength on hover.

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass
items.description: Translucency used where Apple uses it — floating chrome and elevated surfaces. Carries a lit top edge, and turns solid under prefers-reduced-transparency.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: A nav label is a key rather than prose, so it is mono. The active item is marked by a bar at full strength — emphasis without a hue.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer — the colophon
items.description: The legal line names the entity that is liable. The maker line names the person. Keeping them apart is the point of the component.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: There is no accent hue to change to, so the underline carries the state. Goes solid on hover and on focus.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Three weights — glass, solid and quiet — where solid is simply the foreground and background swapped. 44px minimum height on every viewport.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A hint is prose and stays sans; an error is a machine verdict and goes mono. The error is carried by a full-strength bar and full-strength text, because there is no red to reach for.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: The value is what the reader typed, so it is sans; a placeholder is a hint and sits at faint. Focus is a full-strength border plus the standard outline.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Two straight strokes with the mark’s own geometry, drawn in gradients so they flip with the ground rather than shipping two images.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox & radio
items.description: Checked inverts rather than filling with a hue. The 44px target is on the label, not the 20px box, so the hit area is the whole row.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The knob position is a custom property from 0 to 1, so it can be handed to motion.js and re-targeted mid-flight. Without JS it falls back to a transition.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: State is carried by fill: live is inverted, idle is outlined, retired is faint and dashed. The dot marks live only, and it does not pulse.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty state
items.description: The glyph slot takes a mark from the suite at faint, so it reads as furniture rather than an illustration. There is no cartoon.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Floating chrome, so it is the one place glass belongs. A notification that slides across the viewport is asking for attention it has not earned.

items.name: kv
items.title: Key–value table
items.description: The key is mono because a machine would emit it. The value is sans if it is a word and mono if it is an identifier.

items.name: code
items.title: Code block
items.description: A copy control in the corner, mono uppercase so it reads as a key rather than a button competing with the code. Always visible on touch.

items.name: made-by
items.title: Made by — the attribution lockup
items.description: Derives every colour from the surrounding foreground, so it adapts on either ground without a second rule. React and plain CSS, because not every site has a build step.

items.name: marks
items.title: Marks
items.description: One 64-unit grid, one stroke weight, round caps, currentColor. The heart is the frame inverted; the tool is a hexagonal ring spanner because a hexagon is straight lines.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: Straight strokes, round caps, filled nodes at termini, hexagons for anything mechanical. A filled node is a terminus; an open node is a working end.

items.name: primitives
items.title: Primitives
items.description: The five surfaces the brand is actually made of, installed together. Each is also available on its own.

items.name: suite
items.title: The whole suite
items.description: Tokens, type, layout, controls, feedback, data and brand. Roughly 30KB of CSS before compression, and you own all of it on copy.
